conviction_note: The two measurements are near zero for different reasons. Volume and price data roughly cancel against a bar of about $250M: IQVIA TRx for Q3 to date are up about 11% q/q, which implies Auvelity near $200M at Q2's net price per script, against a cut consensus of $209-216M; wholesale dollars are up 25% q/q, and management guided gross-to-net improvement from about 50%. NBRx records, a reset positioning and a 6-of-8 up history lean slightly positive against a 3.6-point put skew, so p_up is 52 on an 8% absolute move. The findings sum to +1.0 and the scaled number is +0.32; the gap is the weight the skew and the TRx shortfall get in p_up, not a fit.

findings.finding: IQVIA data for Q3 to date show Auvelity total prescriptions up about 10-11% q/q. The first 12 weeks of Q3 had 239,600 TRx against 216,648 in the first 12 weeks of Q2, and weekly TRx were flat at 21,200-21,400 in early to mid October. At Q2's net revenue per company-reported script ($180.3M / 266k = $678), that implies Auvelity near $200M against consensus of $209-216M. B. Riley's IQVIA read on 2026-09-25 also shows wholesale purchase dollars up 25% q/q, which points the other way (price, gross-to-net or channel fill). Netted, Auvelity lands roughly $200-225M around the bar, with the volume read slightly below it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-10): revenue of $218.4M missed the $221-224.5M consensus and the stock still rose +3.83% over the window. Q1 2026 (2026-05-04): +8.31%. This name has not punished a small revenue miss in the last eight prints (6 of 8 up).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The IQVIA volume is public, Mizuho cut Auvelity to $208.9M on 10-21, and the stock is down 20% in 20 days. If it were fully priced, consensus Auvelity would sit near $200M rather than $209-216M. The wholesale-dollar half is in one broker note and has not reached consensus.
findings.independence: Weekly IQVIA counts on StockTwits (retail posts of Oct 7, 9 and 16; https://stocktwits.com/symbol/AXSM) give the same about +10.6% q/q. Both rest on IQVIA, so this is one data source read two ways and is filed as one finding.

findings.finding: Auvelity new-to-brand prescriptions hit a record 3,800 a week in mid-September, against averages of about 2,400 in Q1 and 3,000 in Q2. Medicare 65+ rose from about 19% of NBRx before the Alzheimer's agitation (ADA) approval to about 31%. Management said Q3 is the first quarter to show steady-state conversion and that it may disclose extra ADA launch metrics with Q3, which would be the first full-quarter launch data on the line that drives the forward multiple.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Launch-data days have moved the stock up: +6% on 2026-09-11 when Mizuho called the ADA launch a 'strong start' on Symphony August data (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/axsm-jumps-6-as-mizuho-calls-auvelity-s-alzheimer-s-launch-a-strong-start/cZtXr0oRBbQ), and +8.31% on the Q1 print after the ADA approval.
findings.why_not_priced: The numbers are public and the stock fell about 35% after they were said, so the market has discounted company-reported NBRx against syndicated TRx; management itself acknowledged a gap between the two. If the market priced the NBRx at face value, the stock would not sit 8% above its 52-week low with put skew bid. A Q3 conversion figure would resolve that gap either way.
findings.independence: The Cantor conference of 2026-09-10 (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/axsome-at-cantor-healthcare-conference-auvelity-growth-accelerates-93CH-4896759) says the TRx inflection appeared in Symphony and IQVIA in late August and that samples run well ahead of scripts. Mizuho's Symphony read on 2026-09-11: August starter-dose Rx +32% vs July. Mizuho on 2026-10-21: July-September ADA trends 'remain positive'.

findings.finding: The Phase 3 ENGAGE topline readout (solriamfetol in binge eating disorder, about 450 patients, 12 weeks) is guided for 4Q 2026 in the Q2 release. No topline had been announced by 2026-10-30, so it could come with or around the Q3 release. It is a binary outcome with no directional evidence either way.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Mixed Phase 3 Alzheimer's data drew a -5% day ('Axsome slides nearly 5% as investors digest mixed trial data', rallies.ai); no prior BED readout exists.
findings.resolves_by: 2026-11-02 if bundled with the release; otherwise later in 4Q 2026 (outside the window)
findings.why_not_priced: The timing is unknown, so the option market can only price it as part of the 12.3% event move. It adds variance, not direction.
findings.independence: The Quartr Q2 summary (https://quartr.com/events/axsome-therapeutics-inc-axsm-q2-2026_onXaMkL9) repeats ENGAGE topline in 4Q 2026; the Morgan Stanley transcript gives no date.

findings.finding: Expectations have been reset. The stock is down from above $220 in September to about $144 (-43.6% from the 52-week high, 8% above the low), with no company-specific negative filing since 2026-08-10. Sell-side targets were trimmed but ratings held (median target $271), short interest is moderate (6.4% of float, 4.4 days), and the name rose after 6 of its last 8 prints.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Six of the last eight prints were up (baseline), including after the Q2 revenue miss.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced by definition, since this is the price. It is filed as an inference: the put skew (+3.57) still pays for downside after a 20% slide, and a market that had fully de-risked would show flatter skew. This is a proxy and not a company number, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Quiver 2026-10-13 (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Why+Axsome+Therapeutics+shares+are+falling+today): the decline is attributed to profit-taking and target trims, with no new company setback; EDGAR shows no 8-K since 2026-08-10.

findings.finding: Management guided that SG&A plateaus at Q2's $208.1M, that gross-to-net for Auvelity and Sunosi (each about 50% in Q2) improves through the year, and that revenue outgrows opex. With quarterly burn of about $25M and $319.9M of cash, a flat-opex quarter on about $30M more revenue narrows the loss toward the -$0.62 consensus, from -$0.99 in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 EPS of -$0.99 was in line with the -$0.99 consensus and the stock rose +3.83%; the EPS line has not been the driver.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely inside what the company guided, so it is mostly priced. The EPS consensus already moved to about -$0.62. The gross-to-net detail comes from an AI-translated transcript summary (statementdog search snippet; the page returned empty), so it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: The Morgan Stanley transcript of 2026-09-14 says SG&A flattens in 2H and burn is about $25M a quarter (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/axsome-therapeutics-at-morgan-stanley-conference-growth-pipeline-and-cash-93CH-4900221).

baseline_tension: The evidence is near-balanced. The IQVIA TRx shortfall against consensus agrees with the +3.57 put skew and the 20% slide; the NBRx records and reset positioning cut against them, with too little weight to override the skew. p_up therefore stays at 52.
lessons_applied: Rule on two readings of one document: merged the IQVIA TRx finding (-1.5) and the IQVIA wholesale-dollar finding (+1.0) into one netted finding at -0.3, because both come from one B. Riley/IQVIA read.
Rule 1 (reaction history): this name rose +3.83% on the Q2 revenue miss and 6 of 8 prints were up, so the TRx miss risk is not sized as a large negative.
Rule 7 (sign against skew): the NBRx/launch finding was cut from +1.5 to +0.8 because it runs against +3.57 skew and its own data is company-reported; p_up moved from 53 to 52.
Rule 5 and the definition's 'cheap is not a finding': the positioning finding was cut from +0.8 to +0.3 as an inference.
Rule 6 (inside what was guided): the opex/GTN finding was cut from +0.3 to +0.2 because SG&A plateau and GTN improvement were guided.
Rule 6: AXS-12 PDUFA and SUSTAIN kept in outside_window; ENGAGE kept at 0 with resolves_by flagged as uncertain.
